concepts.name: Linear exchange networks with frames and roles
concepts.gloss: A fixed linear network of gates on wires (roles) exchanging two banks of values and restoring auxiliary values; with invertible frames D_v per vertex, gates act pointwise and intermediate frames cancel, leaving an endpoint operator on each role array.

evidence.quote: A wire's fixed place in the network is called its role.
We call $D_v$ its frame
and restores every auxiliary value.

concepts.name: Three-element subset construction with rank saving
concepts.gloss: Subspaces of an m-dimensional space labelled by three-element subsets, using gather/scatter and auxiliary wires, make adjacent edge operators nested so the total number s of smaller calls is less than W·m.

evidence.quote: The construction uses three-element subsets: gather and scatter create coefficients depending on intersection size, and auxiliary wires cancel the unwanted coefficients.
The decisive property is that the total number $s$ of smaller calls satisfies $s<Wm$.

concepts.name: Recursive power saving from s < Wm
concepts.gloss: A recursive call at parameter mf uses s calls at parameter f on volume V/W each, so the per-volume cost multiplies by s/W < m, giving cost V·(parameter)^θ with θ<1.

evidence.quote: This strict inequality is the source of the power saving.

concepts.name: Address shear and lower triangular factorization
